title: A record kind file
description: One YAML file per record kind (decision 9.12): region/kinds/<kind>.yaml for core kinds, region/ext/<feature>/kinds/<kind>.yaml for a feature's. It declares the JSON Schema of the record's data plus the annotations the store needs. region.core.features.check_kind validates a kind file against this schema, checks that 'schema' is itself a valid JSON Schema 2020-12, and checks every x-unit and x-vocab against region/kinds/_vocab.yaml.

kind.description: The kind's name, equal to the file name without .yaml. Used in URLs (/api/v1/k/<kind>), refs and the kind table.

version.description: The current data version (kv). Raising it needs an upgrader up_<n>(data) -> data for every n below it, in upgrade/<kind>.py.

title.description: A short name for the app (Section, Platform).

description.description: What one record of this kind is, in plain sentences.

geometry.description: The geometry type of the record's geom (EPSG:26916 metres), 'none' for records without one, 'any' for mixed.

columns.description: Promoted columns, each derived from data by a JSON pointer, so a column can never disagree with the data (9.9).

dates.description: Pointers into data of the partial ISO dates (YYYY or YYYY-MM) a built thing opens and closes on; stored as month intervals (9.16). Undated built records count only at the present.

refs.description: References from data to other records. A '*' segment stands for every item of an array or every value of an object (/stops/*/platform).

kind.description: The kind, or kinds, the id must resolve to.

role.description: The ref's role in the ref table; defaults to the last segment of path that is not '*'.

on_delete.description: What deleting the target does: restrict refuses the delete (409), cascade tombstones this record too, nullify sets the ref to null.

required.description: Whether a null or absent ref is invalid.

merge.description: How a change below one of Ben's revisions is merged (9.11).

unit.description: field: top-level data fields merge separately. atomic: the record is one unit (a profile, per the 1 November ruling).

rebase.description: auto: a change below that touches only fields Ben did not change, and no geometry or guarded field, applies as its own listed rebase changeset. proposal: every change below becomes a conflict row with a proposed revision.

guard.description: Data pointers (chainage, for example) whose change below always becomes a proposal, as geometry does.

legacy.description: Legacy kinds (lkind) whose old keys map to records of this kind through the legacy index.

seeded.description: Whether main and proposal revisions of this kind are written to region/seed (9.24). Derived or bulky kinds say false.

schema.description: The JSON Schema 2020-12 of the record's data. Strict for the fields engines read, with an open attrs object for import provenance. Every number carries x-unit.

pointer.description: An RFC 6901 JSON pointer into data.

refPointer.description: A JSON pointer into data in which a '*' segment matches every array item or object value.

node.description: A subschema. A subschema that admits numbers must declare x-unit; x-vocab names a list of region/kinds/_vocab.yaml a string must belong to.
